section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single cross-sectional study of 247 women (ages 18–58) collected online examining relations between body appreciation, BMI, and sexual function. Body appreciation was modestly negatively related to BMI, BMI was not related to sexual function, and body appreciation (controlling for sexual orientation, partner status, and age) predicted arousal, orgasm, and satisfaction.
section_summary.evidence_source: This study explored relations between body appreciation and sexual function in women and assessed whether body size impacted this relationship. Cross-sectional data were collected online from 247 women, ages 18 to 58. Body appreciation scores were modestly negatively correlated with BMI, while BMI was not related to sexual function scores. After controlling for sexual orientation, partner status, and age, body appreciation predicted the arousal, orgasm, and satisfaction aspects of sexual function.
